title: ING-02b — EPUB, HTML/web snapshots, and hardened fetch service
commit_message: feat(ingestion): ING-02b EPUB/HTML + hardened fetch service (ARCH-06/19 subsets)

hardened_fetch: Custom httpx/httpcore transport validates every DNS candidate and dials a selected numeric address while preserving the original HTTP origin for Host and TLS SNI
Private, loopback, link-local/metadata, multicast, reserved, IPv4-mapped IPv6, NAT64, 6to4, and Teredo-embedded private addresses are rejected before connector invocation
Manual redirect processing revalidates every hop; direct literals, redirect-to-private, DNS rebinding, and private proxy destinations use the same pre-connect policy
Fetches cap bytes, total wall-clock time including streamed body consumption, redirects, schemes, and ports
Capture records retain requested/final URL, timestamp, status, selected response headers, redirect chain, size, and SHA-256
html: selectolax readability-style extraction removes executable/chrome elements and emits canonical text only
Canonical web locators retain final URL, capture timestamp, DOM path, and heading ancestry
epub: EbookLib extraction runs only after the shared bounded ZIP preflight
Unsafe archive paths, encrypted members, oversized members, unsafe XML declarations/entities, and external resource fetch references are rejected
Chapter and block locators provide stable canonical structure
pipeline: Isolated parser dispatch with typed web locator context
Fetch provenance persisted in parse job payload
POST /api/v1/sources/web-url wired through the dedicated fetch service
Composition owns and closes the shared fetch client/transport

cases: private numeric literal denied before connector
all DNS candidates validated before connector
public-then-private rebinding denied before second connect
total wall-clock deadline includes delayed streamed body

packages/adapters/src/milpbooklm_adapters/parsers/epub.py — EbookLib extraction behind the shared bounded-archive preflight; unsafe paths, encryption, entities, oversized members and external fetch references rejected

packages/adapters/src/milpbooklm_adapters/parsers/html.py — selectolax readability-style snapshot, canonical text only; canonical web locators (final URL, capture timestamp, DOM path, heading ancestry)
